idea-plugin.name: Tide Pets
idea-plugin.description:
Tide Pets — sea creatures that keep you company while you code

A pet swims along the bottom of your editor and reacts to what you do. Pick one: Shelly the sea turtle, Bloop the jellyfish, Inky the octopus, Pinchy the crab or Puff the pufferfish.

  • Typing — swims faster
  • Saving — a happy loop and a few bubbles
  • New errors in the open file — looks worried, and hides when a lot appear at once (the octopus inks, the pufferfish puffs up)
  • Errors fixed — celebrates
  • Run configurations — cheers when one passes, hides when one fails
  • Debugging — brings out a magnifying glass
  • Switching files — looks around
  • Idle for a few minutes — naps
  • Clicked — does a spin

The pet sits in the bottom-right corner of the editor. Drag it anywhere along the bottom edge and it stays there; turn on Swim Around to let it roam. It only takes clicks on itself, and while you work on a line it covers it fades and lets your clicks through. Right-click it to choose a pet, let it swim, or hide it; Settings → Tools → Tide Pets sets its size and name.

Made to go with the Midnight Tide theme, and works with any theme.

Free and open source (MIT): github.com/Chelayel/tide-pets.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0 — Four new pets: Bloop the jellyfish, Inky the octopus, Pinchy the crab and Puff the pufferfish. The pet now floats at the bottom of the editor instead of living in a tool window: drag it where you want it, or let it swim around; it fades out of the way of the line you're working on. Right-click it or use Tools → Tide Pets to choose one; Settings → Tools → Tide Pets for its size and name. New logo.

0.1.1 — First release on the Marketplace (0.1.0 was built but not uploaded).

0.1.0 — First release: Shelly the sea turtle.
